core_obligations: The function n -> chi(Z, L|_Z^{tensor n}) is a numerical polynomial of degree 1 (dimension of Z at most 1, leading-term companion lemma) (proof lines 10683-10687).

For a degree-1 numerical polynomial the leading coefficient is the difference of consecutive values; by the definition of (L  dot  Z) this difference is (L  dot  Z), and by the definition of the degree of an invertible sheaf on a dimension <= 1 closed subscheme it is deg(L|_Z) (proof lines 10683-10687).
If L is ample, the definition of the L-degree gives deg_L(Z) = deg(L|_Z) (proof lines 10683-10687).
proof_roadmap: Identify both sides as the leading coefficient (equivalently, consecutive difference) of the same degree-1 numerical polynomial.
